data.one_liner: A customizable animated bar or wave graph for audio visualization.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget that renders customizable animated bar graphs or wave graphs. It allows adjusting dimensions, colors, spacing, and animation properties like beat rate and loops.
use_when: You need to display a simple animated audio waveform or bar graph UI.
You want to customize bar heights, spacing, radius, and colors.
avoid_when: You need actual audio playback or recording functionality.
You require complex real-time frequency analysis or microphone stream processing.
strengths: Highly customizable bar properties (height, color, radius).
Supports built-in animations with configurable beat rates and loops.
weaknesses: Does not process or analyze actual audio data automatically; height factors must be handled manually.
Limited to basic bar and wave graph representations.
